name: Vigilante Casting Savant
body:
You gain a masked talent.

Prerequisite(s): Vigilante level 5th, must have an archetype with the alchemy or spellcasting class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a vigilante talent.

Special: You cannot select this feat if you possess the Vigilante Savant feat.
